simple.meaning: עָבַט (ʻâbaṭ) is a Hebrew word meaning “to pawn ; causatively, to lend (on security); figuratively, to entangle.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: עָבַט (H5670) appears 6 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Deuteronomy 15:6, with occurrences in Deuteronomy, Joel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עָבַט (H5670) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in עָבַט (H5670) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: עָבַט (ʻâbaṭ) / H5670 is traced through Deuteronomy 15:6, Deuteronomy 15:8, Deuteronomy 24:10, Joel 2:7 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.short: to pawn ; causatively, to lend (on security); figuratively, to entangle
definitions.usage: borrow, break (ranks), fetch (a pledge), lend, × surely.
definitions.full: H5670. abat [ עָבַט ] verb denominative take or give a pledge ; — Qal Infinitive construct לַעֲבֹט Deut 24:10 to take possession of a thing pledged (with accusative of congnate meaning with verb); Imperfect 2masculine singular give a pledge תַּעֲבֹט 15:6 (i.e. borrow ). Hiph`il Perfect 2masculine singular רַבִּים גּוֺיִם וְהַעֲבַטְתָּ֫ Deut 15:6 and thou shalt cause many nations to give pledges (i.e. lend to them); Imperfect 3masculine singular suffix + Infinitive absolute תַּעֲבִיטֶנּוּ הַעֲבֵט 15:8 thou shalt surely lend to him (literally as above). Pi`el Imperfect יְעַבְּטוּן Joel 2:7 hardly makes sense ( lend on pledge = interchange ?); most read יְעַבְּתוּן ; יְעַוְּתוּן We, compare Now Dr GASm; Gr. יַטוּן . עבל (√ of following; compare possibly Arabic be bulky, stout ; Punic proper name עבל Lzb 335 ).
